tagline: Istanbul's most exclusive hilltop address — forest villas, the city's finest Bosphorus-view restaurants, and a serenity that money can barely buy.

items.name: Ulus Parkı Çay Bahçesi
items.description: A stunning hilltop tea garden with arguably the best panoramic Bosphorus view in the city. The setting is incomparable.
items.tip: Go on a clear autumn or winter day — fewer people and the Bosphorus views stretch impossibly far in both directions.

items.name: Ulus 29
items.description: Istanbul's most legendary special-occasion restaurant. Set in a stunning villa with jaw-dropping Bosphorus views. Turkish cuisine at its finest.
items.tip: Book at least two weeks in advance. Request a terrace table — the indoor dining room is beautiful but the view outside is what you're there for.

items.name: Ulus Parkı
items.description: A beautifully maintained hilltop park with sweeping Bosphorus views. Morning walks here feel entirely removed from the city below.

tips: Ulus is accessible only by taxi from Levent metro or Etiler. No public transport.
One of Istanbul's most exclusive residential areas — primarily villas and embassies.
The park and restaurant are the two reasons to visit. Both are exceptional.
Combine with Etiler (downhill) for a fuller afternoon in this part of the city.
